question: 查询所有处于已支付状态（PAID）的订单ID和订单总金额
ground_truth_sql: SELECT id, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'PAID' ORDER BY id ASC;

question: 统计价格大于50元的商品名称与标牌单价
ground_truth_sql: SELECT product_name, price FROM products WHERE price > 50 ORDER BY price DESC;

question: 列出所有来自北京的客户姓名和注册时间
ground_truth_sql: SELECT name, created_at FROM customers WHERE city = '北京' ORDER BY id ASC;

question: 查询库存量低于200件的商品信息
ground_truth_sql: SELECT id, product_name, stock FROM products WHERE stock < 200 ORDER BY stock ASC;

question: 查询评分为5星的所有商品评价内容与日期
ground_truth_sql: SELECT comment, review_date FROM customer_reviews WHERE rating = 5 ORDER BY id ASC;

question: 统计每个城市注册的客户总数量
ground_truth_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(id) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY customer_count DESC, city ASC;

question: 查询客户'张伟'的所有订单ID、下单日期和金额
ground_truth_sql: SELECT o.id, o.order_date, o.total_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.name = '张伟' ORDER BY o.order_date ASC;

question: 统计每个商品品类的商品数量和平均价格
ground_truth_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(id) AS item_count, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY avg_price DESC;

question: 统计已支付订单中每个客户的累计消费总额
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

question: 查询订单号为101的订单中包含的商品名称、购买数量和单价
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_name, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.order_id = 101 ORDER BY oi.id ASC;

question: 查询购买过'100%纯果汁'的客户姓名及订单日期
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name, o.order_date FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE p.product_name = '100%纯果汁' ORDER BY o.order_date ASC;

question: 统计总销售额排名前3的商品名称与销售总金额
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS sales_volume FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY p.id, p.product_name ORDER BY sales_volume DESC LIMIT 3;

question: 查找评价星级为5星且客户所在城市为'北京'的商品名称、客户姓名及评价内容
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_name, c.name, r.comment FROM customer_reviews r JOIN customers c ON r.customer_id = c.id JOIN products p ON r.product_id = p.id WHERE r.rating = 5 AND c.city = '北京' ORDER BY r.id ASC;

question: 找出累计消费金额大于200元的高价值客户姓名与其消费总额
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_val FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING SUM(o.total_amount) > 200 ORDER BY total_val DESC;

question: 计算每个客户的第一笔订单下单日期与总金额
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.name, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order_date, o.total_amount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_date = (SELECT MIN(o2.order_date) FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.customer_id = c.id) GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY first_order_date ASC;
